question: Celebrate the Mountain-king leaves the battlefield before its triggered ability resolves. Are nonland permanents exiled?
board_state: described in the question (no separate board state)
answer: No. If Celebrate the Mountain-king leaves the battlefield before its triggered ability resolves, no nonland permanents will be exiled.

title: Negative power lets Nethroi reanimate far more than 10 power
question: With every player at 40 life, Scourge of the Skyclaves is a -20/-20 in your graveyard. You mutate Nethroi, Apex of Death and choose Scourge among the creatures to return. How much total power of creatures can you return?
board_state: described in the question (no separate board state)
answer: 30 power. Scourge's characteristic-defining ability functions in the graveyard, so its -20 power subtracts from Nethroi's budget: 10 - (-20) = 30.

title: Selvala plus Panglacial Wurm is an irreversible illegal action
question: You are searching your library with Selvala, Explorer Returned untapped, with four players in the game, and you try to cast Panglacial Wurm using her parley ability to pay. It produces too little mana. What happens?
board_state: described in the question (no separate board state)
answer: You have taken an illegal action: the action is reversed and Panglacial Wurm returns to where it came from, but the parley ability can't be fully undone because each player has already revealed and drawn a card, so the game can't simply be rewound.

title: Parley is a mana ability, and it can be used mid-cast
question: Is Selvala, Explorer Returned's parley ability a mana ability, and when can it be activated?
board_state: described in the question (no separate board state)
answer: Yes. It doesn't target, isn't a loyalty ability, and could add mana, so it's a mana ability (CR 605.1a). Mana abilities can be activated during the casting of a spell (CR 601.2g), which is why parley can be used mid-cast.
